name: ui-design-review
description: Review any app or website screen the way a senior designer would: look at the rendered result on phone and desktop, list what to fix most important first, fix the issues you pick in your app's own style, and compare with how real products solve the same thing. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for real iOS app screens and user journeys and design systems from real websites.

interface.longDescription: Review any app or website screen the way a senior designer would: look at the rendered result on phone and desktop, list what to fix most important first, fix the issues you pick in your app's own style, and compare with how real products solve the same thing. The skills work on their own. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for real iOS app screens and user journeys and design systems from real websites.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Compare my app's onboarding with how real iPhone apps do onboarding and tell me what to change.
positive.prompt: Compare my app's onboarding with how real iPhone apps do onboarding and tell me what to change.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds real onboarding journeys in UXKIN, shows a few of their screens, then lists what the user's onboarding does differently and concrete changes, most important first.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: How do real apps design the delete-account flow? Compare it with mine and list what to fix.
positive.prompt: How do real apps design the delete-account flow? Compare it with mine and list what to fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real delete-account journeys step by step, then compares with the user's flow and lists fixes.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Is my pricing page design standard? Compare it with design systems from real SaaS websites.
positive.prompt: Is my pricing page design standard? Compare it with design systems from real SaaS websites.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds design systems from real SaaS websites and compares layout, typography and colors with the user's pricing page, then lists what to change.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Find real paywall screens and review my paywall against them, most important fixes first.
positive.prompt: Find real paywall screens and review my paywall against them, most important fixes first.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real paywall screens from UXKIN and reviews the user's paywall as must fix, should fix and nice to have.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Show me how real products design empty states for a task list, then suggest improvements for mine.
positive.prompt: Show me how real products design empty states for a task list, then suggest improvements for mine.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real empty-state screens and suggests specific improvements to the user's empty state.

publication.release_notes: First release in ChatGPT and Codex. Three skills: ui-review, ui-polish and ui-compare, plus the UXKIN connection for real app screens, user journeys and website design systems.
